limitations: The comparator is a cut-polytope slice under marginal constraints, not the convex hull of deterministically feasible constrained cuts.
Only a uniform star and a unit-weight leaf clique are covered; no weighted arbitrary-graph gap or algorithmic speedup follows.
Older equivalent cut-polytope projection formulations may exist.

scientific_integrity.independence: No independent audit or validation has been performed.
scientific_integrity.proof_method: permutation symmetrization; Schur-complement spectrum; regular-simplex sharpness; concave interpolation of cut cardinalities
scientific_integrity.theorem_domain: integer leaf count at least 2; real uniform tolerance between zero and one-half inclusive; real PSD correlation matrices; full metric triangle inequalities
scientific_integrity.verification: standalone exact-rational checks and optional numerical linear programs support, but do not constitute, the infinite-family proof

title: Exact star-conditioned elliptope–cut gaps for a leaf-clique objective
